title: Image build fills its scratch filesystem
root_cause: The raster script writes pages to an 8 MiB tmpfs mount until it runs out of space. The failed write makes the PHP command exit and the Docker build reports a failed RUN instruction.

relevant_evidence.why: PHP reports a full scratch filesystem inside the Docker build.
The build mounts an 8 MiB scratch filesystem for the script.
The script writes successive pages to that filesystem.
